name: planner
description: Two ChatGPT-ready planners: home room layout and wedding seating, built on one shared engine.

scripts.build:sites: npm run build:site -w @planner/home && npm run build:site -w @planner/wedding
scripts.test:e2e: node --test tests/home.e2e.test.mjs tests/wedding.e2e.test.mjs tests/review-cases.test.mjs tests/smoke.local.test.mjs tests/limits.e2e.test.mjs && node tests/widgets.e2e.mjs && node tests/home-editor.e2e.mjs && node tests/wedding-editor.e2e.mjs
scripts.test:all: npm run typecheck && npm run test:units && npm run build:all && node tests/landing.e2e.mjs && npm run test:e2e && npm run package:plugins
